in_sample_reason: Fit by cfbfastR-cfb-data python/cfb_model_build/model_training/cli.py train-wp --variant spread on the whole training_frame (artifacts/pbp_full_v2.parquet: 22 seasons, 2004-2025, 2,219,971 rows); no season was withheld, so every 2004-2025 score this booster produces is in-sample.
